ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case Record Type is Direct Debit or Direct Entry or NPP and not in the Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue or User doesn't have a Coach, Support Coach, Card Dispute Agent or FraudX Agent Role.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute'), AND( NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Support Coach Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Digital Fraud Queue'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Coach'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Support Coach'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Card Dispute Agent'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'FraudX Agent')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Direct Debit, Direct Entry or NPP record types, please select either Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue or the User must have a Coach, Support Coach, Card Dispute Agent or FraudX Agent Role.
